decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 23:8 explicitly names the plural gentilic Levites cooperating with all Judah in Jehoiada's time; Nehemiah 11:3 lists the postexilic Levite residents. Neither text refers to the ancient individual Levi, son of Jacob. The already-existing group:Levi holds the exact plural word, distributive 'each' and 2 Chronicles action verb groups. Remove only those false son-of-Jacob links, preserving the frozen source. Ezra 8:33 explicitly mentions the plural Levites who helped weigh the returned treasures, not the long-deceased son of Jacob Levi: group:Levi already retains the exact plural gentilic word and passive weighing token. Nehemiah 8:10 follows Nehemiah, Ezra and the Levites teaching contemporary returnees; its speech verb can refer to these living participants, never to the patriarch Levi. Remove only two erroneous source subject words plus the exact Ezra 8:33 name/verse from person:Levi.3, not the legitimate Levitical community.
